title: Did Nvidia Bring Back Jensen Huang to Save the Stock? #Shorts
description:
Did Nvidia bring back Jensen Huang to rescue the stock? The numbers: record close $239.24 on 6 Oct; about $125.5 before his return; +31.5% to $165.05 on 23 Nov. The board says the decision is in the best interests of stockholders, employees, partners and customers. Investigations (House committees, DOJ Megaspeed probe, California AG) continue. Not financial advice.

Sources (checked 24 Nov 2026):
- NVIDIA 8-K, Huang reinstated (23 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000090/nov23pressrelease.htm
- Gotrade (NVDA close 23 Nov): https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-24-2026/
- Yahoo Finance: https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-stock-rockets-141145439.html
- AP via PBS NewsHour: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/nvidia-board-unanimously-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-and-chairman

Allegations mentioned are reports, not proven facts. Our analysis is labelled as such. News, not financial advice.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (Google Flow) and animations; facts checked against the sources above. Independent channel, not affiliated with NVIDIA.
